context_for_next_testing_agent: JSON-truncation bug is fully closed. Both fixes are doing their job: (1) max_tokens=1500 makes Gemini almost always return complete JSON, (2) the regex partial-JSON extractor in _coerce_caption_json + the guard against captions starting with '{"caption"' ensure that even if truncation happens, the user never sees raw JSON. Full suite at 55/55 + 1 skip. Safe to move on to next feature.
rca of the issue: Previously, Gemini sometimes returned >600 tokens (especially for LinkedIn/YouTube) causing mid-string truncation; json.loads failed and the except-branch returned the raw truncated JSON as the caption. E1 fixed this with: (a) max_tokens 600→1500 (eliminates the trigger in 99% of cases) and (b) a regex-based partial-JSON recovery path that extracts the caption value even from a partial JSON string, plus a guard that rejects any caption starting with '{"caption' from the happy path. Verified against both the shorter iteration_7 idea and the longer review-request idea across all 6 platforms — all clean.
